args.subject: Free Consultation Request
args.body:
Hello,

I received your email about your event organizing services and would like to book a free consultation. Please let me know what dates and times you have available.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text: I emailed bookings@best-event-organizers.com, the booking address in the event organizers' email, to request a free consultation. I asked them to send their available dates and times. I haven't received a reply yet.
